visual_logic.composition: A quadrant tiled composition: Top-Left (Birth): A tiny larva inside a pollen-lined cell in a hollow reed; Top-Right (Dining): The bee covered in bright yellow pollen, sipping nectar from a flower; Bottom-Left (Sleeping): Tucked inside a folded leaf overnight; Bottom-Right (Activity): The bee in a 'pollen dance' near a flowering shrub.
visual_logic.style_notes: STYLE_ANIMATED_FEATURE_V3; focus on the 'fuzz' or soft hair on the bee's thorax to make it look approachable and cute for children.
